name: Jagdhof
beschreibung: The 5-star Relais & Châteaux Jagdhof in Neustift in the Stubai Valley represents the pinnacle of luxury Tyrolean hospitality. Blending exquisite alpine woodwork and heritage antiques with contemporary five-star indulgence, the hotel welcomes discerning travelers worldwide. Its expansive 3,000 m² jSPA wellness retreat features an authentic sauna village, heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools, and exclusive private spa suites. Dining is celebrated with multi-award-winning gourmet gastronomy paired with rare vintages from one of Austria's finest wine cellars. Peacefully situated on the outskirts of Neustift, it affords sweeping vistas toward the Stubai Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Exclusive 5-star Relais & Châteaux SPA hotel in Neustift in the Stubai Valley featuring award-winning dining and luxury wellness.
